I have been thinking a lot recently about what the true "good" ending is in Dark Souls, but have come to the conclusion that it is not black and white. I personally think that linking the fire is the better ending, as it is about sacrificing yourself for the greater good to allow the human race to flourish anew, if only for a limited time. The dark lord ending on the other hand I cannot see being in humanities best interest, as it would lead to the spread of the abyss thus allowing humanity to run rampant and transform humans in to hideous creatures à la Oolacile. It brings to mind the verse from paradise lost, It is better to reign in hell than serve in heaven. A very selfish creed IMO.

As for the serpents, I think they are both only self serving, although their motives are unknown to me. I find it especially odd that if the dark lord ending is chosen, Kaathe and Frampt are there pledging their service, even though Frampt, for the entire game, was driving you to link the flame.

I would love to hear other peoples opinions on the real "good" ending, also to hear peoples theories on the serpents motivations/alignments.

Inb4 Solaire links the flame.
